settings.heading: Your Path To Healing Begins Here
settings.subheading: The body holds what the mind cannot yet process. At Center for Balanced Living, we integrate nature based care, somatic awareness, and evidence-based trauma treatment for individuals, families, and children navigating complex trauma, anxiety, and developmental wounds.

settings.statement: The most meaningful change does not come from fixing what is wrong. It comes from understanding the patterns that have been shaping us all along.

settings.title: Trauma-Based Therapy
settings.description: One-on-one therapy for adults and adolescents navigating complex trauma, anxiety, grief, and identity disruption. We draw on EMDR, IFS, somatic experiencing, and attachment-based approaches. Treatment is tailored to your window of tolerance.

settings.title: Psychological Evaluations
settings.description: Comprehensive evaluations for children, adolescents, and adults. We assess for autism, ADHD, learning differences, and complex trauma presentations. Reports are written for clinical utility, not just diagnosis.

settings.title: Wellness Groups
settings.description: Community-grounded groups focused on grief, somatic resourcing, and nervous system regulation. Structured and time-limited, informed by current research in polyvagal theory and group trauma treatment.

settings.heading: One practice. Three doors.
settings.subheading: Center for Balanced Living, CFBL Institute, and MUSA each serve a distinct audience with a distinct clinical voice. Three doors. One integrated practice.
settings.cfbl_body: Therapy, psychological evaluation, and groups for individuals and families. Trauma-informed care in Townsend, DE.
settings.inst_body: Continuing education in trauma-based practice, assessment, and applied clinical reasoning. For licensed clinicians.
settings.musa_body: Books, essays, and longer-form writing on psychology, healthcare and being human. A publication by Dr. Niki Serravalle.

settings.name: Dr. Angela (Niki) Serravalle
settings.bio_short: A trauma-based psychologist, educator, and writer. Founder of Center for Balanced Living, CFBL Institute, and MUSA.

settings.title: Assessment for the Trauma Clinician
settings.description: A workshop integrating psychometric assessment with nervous system theory. For licensed clinicians working in trauma, forensic, and educational settings.

settings.heading: New writing on psychology, memory, and being human.

settings.title: The Quiet Room
settings.lede: The body keeps a record that the mind is still learning to read. This essay explores what clinical work reveals about traumatic memory, the limits of narrative, and why trauma treatment must begin below the neck.

settings.heading: Ready to take the first step?
settings.subheading: We are accepting new clients. A free 15-minute consultation helps us understand what you are looking for and whether we are the right fit.
settings.footnote: Townsend, DE · In-person and telehealth · Most insurance accepted

settings.heading: Stay connected
settings.description: New trainings from the Institute, new essays from MUSA, and occasional updates from the practice. We write when we have something worth saying.
